facts.partWayNote: Head-to-head not complete: they have not all played each other yet.
facts.footballThreeWay: one pass of a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, then goal difference (straight after the first measure)
facts.cricketThreeWay: one pass of a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, then seeding (after wins, net run rate)
facts.boardgameThreeWay: a direct encounter: the points each tied player scored against the others, counted once (straight after the first measure)
facts.carromThreeWay: one pass of a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, then drawing of lots (after wins, set ratio, board ratio, point ratio)
facts.genericThreeWay: one pass of a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, then drawing of lots (after difference, total scored)
facts.volleyballThreeWay: one pass of a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, then drawing of lots (after points, set ratio, point ratio)
facts.badmintonThreeWay: head-to-head only between two: with three level it is skipped, and it comes back once a later step leaves exactly two (first checked straight after the first measure)
facts.tabletennisThreeWay: a mini-league of the games among the tied players, started again among only those still level each time it separates someone (straight after the first measure)
facts.tennisThreeWay: head-to-head only between two: with three level it is skipped, and it comes back once a later step leaves exactly two (first checked after matches played)
facts.icehockeyThreeWay: a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, re-applied to any smaller group it leaves level (straight after the first measure)
facts.hockeyThreeWay: one pass of a mini-league of the games among the tied teams, then field goals (after wins, goal difference, goals scored)
facts.partialScheduleOrder: fewest games played, goal difference, goals scored, seeding
